Package hadur117.core.model

Class TickMap

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.model.TickMap
final class TickMap extends Object
TIME-12: a map from tick to robot state that keeps no boxed Long and no entry object per state, for RobotStateLog, which every tick fills, reads and (in the surf) copies and walks.

It iterates in exactly the order a java.util.HashMap<Long, RobotState> would, because the surf's danger sums read a predicted log in that order and a different order would change their rounding (CORE-2: the fixtures must replay bit for bit). So it uses HashMap's own scheme: the hash of a Long spread as HashMap spreads it, a power-of-two table that starts at 16 and doubles past a load of 0.75, new keys appended to the end of their bucket's chain, a resize splitting each chain into a low and a high chain in the same relative order, a chain of 8 in a table under 64 resizing instead of growing, removal unlinking in place, and clear keeping the table's size. The one part of HashMap it does not copy is turning a chain of 8 or more into a tree in a table of 64 or more: tick keys in one log are bounded by RobotStateLog.MAX_STATES, so a chain there holds keys a table's length apart and never comes near 8.
